<img src="https://thirteenag.github.io/screens/re0/main2.jpg" width="760" alt="Resident Evil 0 Fusion Fix">

**Resident Evil 0 Fusion Fix** adds door skipping, cursor hiding, borderless windowed mode, visual filter toggles, and Logitech RGB lighting.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#re0) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/ResidentEvil0.FusionFix/dllmain.cpp) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/ResidentEvil0.FusionFix/scripts/ResidentEvil0.FusionFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Options

- **Mouse cursor** — Hide the cursor after a configurable interval.
- **Door animations** — Skip door transitions.
- **Windowed mode** — Enable borderless windowed mode.
- **Color correction** — Optionally disable color correction.
- **Noise filter** — Optionally disable the noise filter.
- **RGB lighting** — Support [Logitech G LIGHTSYNC RGB Lighting](https://www.logitechg.com/innovation/lightsync-rgb.html).

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the game folder, beside the game executable, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Optionally edit `scripts/ResidentEvil0.FusionFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game.
